name: Web App Launch Readiness
description: Checks whether a web application is ready for real users: product, performance, operations and compliance.

thresholds.label: Not ready
thresholds.summary: Launching now would likely mean outages or support issues in the first weeks.

thresholds.label: Almost there
thresholds.summary: Most of the work is done. Close the remaining gaps before announcing the launch.

thresholds.label: Ready to launch
thresholds.summary: The application looks ready for real users. Keep monitoring closely during launch week.

recommendations.not-ready: Finish and test the main user journeys end to end before anything else.
recommendations.almost: Run a short beta with real users and fix the top issues they report.
recommendations.ready: Prepare a simple way for users to report problems after launch.

questions.label: Share of core user journeys that are complete and tested
Has the app been tried by real users outside the team?
How many known critical bugs are still open?

recommendations.not-ready: Measure page load and API response times; fix anything above a few seconds.
recommendations.almost: Load-test the busiest endpoints with expected launch traffic.
recommendations.ready: Set up alerts on response times so regressions are caught early.

recommendations.not-ready: Automate deployment and add basic uptime monitoring before go-live.
recommendations.almost: Add error tracking and confirm database backups can actually be restored.
recommendations.ready: Write a short runbook for the most likely incidents.

questions.label: How complete is monitoring (uptime, errors, logs)?

categories.name: Security & Compliance
categories.description: Legal pages, data handling and basic security.

recommendations.not-ready: Add a privacy policy, enforce HTTPS and review who can access production data.
recommendations.almost: Run a basic security review of authentication and input validation.
recommendations.ready: Schedule a periodic dependency and security update review.

questions.label: How thoroughly has security been reviewed?

report.title: Launch Readiness Scorecard
report.intro: A one-page view of how ready this application is for real users, scored per area against the launch checklist configuration.
report.footer: Generated with Scorecard Studio. Scores reflect the answers provided.
